goodsServices.description: 第037類:不動產（包括居住型社區、購物中心、餐飲店、旅館、建築物、不動產建物、辦公室、公共設施及停車場）之營建、保養及修理；建築物營建及拆除服務；建築物營建、整修及拆除之監督；土木建築工程施工；防火、防水及隔熱施工服務；纜線鋪設，電線安裝服務，玻璃安裝，砌磚、砌石，油漆施工及裝潢施工，配管及管道鋪設，塗抹灰泥，配管工程施工，土木建築工程之鉚接，屋頂鋪設及鷹架搭建；建築物、房屋及辦公室之修理、修繕、修復、整修、裝潢、保養及維修；建築物之清潔；路燈、商業及住宅區用照明設備之修理、安裝及保養；道路、排水系統、電梯、管線、通訊、供熱及照明及環境控制系統之建造、維護、清潔及修理；火災及安全警報系統之安裝及修理；公共工程施工；與上述服務有關之資訊、顧問及諮詢服務。 第042類:建築設計服務；與土地開發有關之建築設計服務；土木建築工程設計；室內裝潢設計；居住型社區、購物中心、餐飲店、旅館、建築物、不動產建物、辦公室、公共設施及停車場之設計服務；空間規劃；都市設計及計劃；建築物結構安全、建築物使用／佔用人員人身安全、以及建築物之營建、保養及修理人員人身安全之評估檢查服務；測量服務；防盜設備工程規劃設計；消防工程規劃設計；建築物結構安全、建築物使用／佔用人員人身安全、以及建築物之營建、保養及修理人員人身安全之安全評估；與上述服務有關之資訊、顧問及諮詢服務。
goodsServices.translation: Class 037: Construction, maintenance and repair of real estate (including residential communities, shopping malls, restaurants, hotels, buildings, real estate buildings, offices, public facilities and parking lots); building construction and demolition services; building construction , supervision of renovation and demolition; civil engineering construction; fire protection, waterproofing and insulation construction services; cable laying, wire installation services, glass installation, bricklaying, masonry, painting construction and decoration construction, piping and pipe laying, painting Stucco, piping engineering construction, riveting of civil construction engineering, roofing and scaffolding; repair, repair, repair, renovation, decoration, maintenance and repair of buildings, houses and offices; cleaning of buildings; street lights, commercial and Repair, installation and maintenance of lighting equipment for residential areas; construction, maintenance, cleaning and repair of roads, drainage systems, elevators, pipelines, communications, heating and lighting and environmental control systems; installation and repair of fire and security alarm systems; Public works construction; information, consulting and consulting services related to the above services. Class 042: Architectural design services; architectural design services related to land development; civil engineering design; interior decoration design; residential communities, shopping malls, restaurants, hotels, buildings, real estate buildings, offices, public facilities and parking Site design services; space planning; urban design and planning; assessment and inspection services for building structural safety, personal safety of building users/occupants, and personal safety of building construction, maintenance and repair personnel; surveying services; anti-theft equipment engineering Planning and design; fire engineering planning and design; safety assessment of building structural safety, personal safety of building users/occupants, and personal safety of building construction, maintenance and repair personnel; information, consulting and consulting services related to the above services.
